scripts.init:project: npm run scaffold && npm run install:deps && npm run configure
scripts.init:project:win: npm run scaffold && npm run install:deps && npm run configure:win
scripts.scaffold: npm run scaffold:backend && npm run scaffold:frontend
scripts.scaffold:backend: npx -y shx mkdir -p backend && cd backend && uv init && uv python pin 3.14 && uv add fastapi[standard] ffmpeg-python
scripts.install:deps: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm i --save-dev electron concurrently wait-on
scripts.configure: npm run copy:files && npm run config:scripts
scripts.configure:win: npm run copy:files && npm run config:scripts:win
scripts.copy:files: npm run copy:backend && npm run copy:frontend
scripts.config:scripts: cd frontend && npm pkg set main="main.cjs" && npm pkg set scripts.electron="electron . --no-sandbox" && npm pkg set scripts.start="concurrently \"npm run dev\" \"wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run electron\"" && npm pkg set scripts.web="concurrently \"npm run dev\" \"cd ../backend && uv run fastapi dev main.py --app app\""
scripts.config:scripts:win: cd frontend && npm pkg set main="main.cjs" && npm pkg set scripts.dev="vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" && npm pkg set scripts.electron="electron . --no-sandbox" && npm pkg set scripts.start="concurrently \"npm run dev\" \"npm run electron\"" && npm pkg set scripts.web="concurrently \"npm run dev\" \"uv --directory ../backend run fastapi dev main.py --app app\""
scripts.start:win: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location frontend; Start-Process cmd.exe -ArgumentList '/c','npm.cmd run dev' -WindowStyle Normal; $url='http://127.0.0.1:5173/'; Write-Host ('[wait] ' + $url); while ($true) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $url -Method Get -TimeoutSec 2; if ($r.StatusCode -eq 200) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; break } } catch {} Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200 }; Start-Process cmd.exe -ArgumentList '/c','npx.cmd electron . --no-sandbox' -WindowStyle Normal"
scripts.web:win: npm run config:scripts:win && npm run web
